title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E7 — Never Enough Cookies
Giant fruit and nut kitchen sink cookies; vanilla sugar cookie sorbet sandwiches; maple-pecan shortbread squares; double chocolate sandwich cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E9 — One-Bowl Desserts
Brown-butter coconut cashew blondies; skilled baked plum cake; single-serving size brownie sundaes; Scottish oatcakes.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E1 — Classic New England
Maple custard pie; cranberry tart with a walnut crust; Boston cream pie cupcakes; buttermilk-blueberry tart.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E8 — Grains
Mushroom barley soup; couscous royale; grits with broiled tomatoes, cheddar cheese and bacon.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E9 — Sauces
Béarnaise sauce; Kansas City barbecue sauce; tartar sauce with capers, shallots and cornichons; cocktail sauce; salsa verde.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E10 — Pork
Porchetta, a highly seasoned roasted pork; glazed ham; pork and plums.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E11 — Potatoes
Scalloped potatoes; potato salad; puréed potatoes; smashed potatoes.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E3 — Midwest
Polka-dotted, double-crusted sour cherry pie; St. Louis butter cake; kransekake; sweet custard pie made with navy beans.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E4 — Northwest
A biscuit-topped blackberry cobbler; fig bars; Idaho potato cake; hazelnut cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E5 — Southern Classics
Hummingbird cake layered with banana, pineapple and pecans; sweet potato pie; old-fashioned hot milk cake with chocolate whipped cream frosting.

description:
S7 E6 — New England
Cheddar-crusted apple pie; steamed Boston brown bread made in a can; lemon-blueberry tart; hermit bars.

Southern caramel cake; Mississippi mud tart; Lane cake; cheese straws.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E10 — West
Blum's coffee crunch cake; gâteau Basque, a dessert filled with pastry cream and cherries; pineapple upside-down cakes; date bars.

description:

Anise seed-flavored cookies called biscochitos; flan, a custard topped with caramel; tres leches cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:

Buttermilk pie; bourbon bread pudding; carrot cake with orange cream cheese frosting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E5 — Shellfish
Martha takes shellfish to the next level with sustainable oysters, baked stuffed clams and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E6 — Steak Night
From a pan seared steak with bordelaise sauce to a classic sizzling steak fired up on the grill, Martha makes steak dinners cooked to perfection with the help of her Head of Culinary at the farm.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E8 — Paella on an Open Fire
Martha creates the perfect menu for a paella party that will have your guests coming back for seconds; her paella is served with gazpacho and her incredible sangria.
